scope: Neural-network function approximation. A fixed-weight dense layer with tanh activation is compared against direct Fortran matrix multiplication and TANH. This does not test training, automatic derivatives, graph convolutions or model accuracy on a dataset. K remains broad.
compatibility_edits: Remove the optional W&B features table for FPM 0.12; declare its preprocessor-disabled wf module external for the dependency scanner. W&B tracking is unavailable; mathematical sources are unchanged.
